meta.title: A started round cannot be moved to a later window, and its clock is untouched
gaps: verifying the exact error message text 'You cannot re-schedule this event!'

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer moves the round's bid end time.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that “status” equals active.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You cannot re-schedule this event!”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: “status” equals active.
